name: @etzhayyim/webpage-rw-free
description: RW-free reference implementation of webpage (web-page authoring & publishing: space → page document model) using @etzhayyim/sdk. Registry on AT PDS (replaces RW). (a) content-editor product (editor/pptx/xlsx cluster); first-party user-authored pages + public published-page directory. No hosting-of-others / custom domains / settlement (contrast webya). Substrate posture per ADR-2605172000.
